meta.description: Sports betting, lottery and casino in BRL and MXN.

footer.responsible: Gambling can be addictive. Play responsibly. Only for people aged 18 and over. Set deposit limits or take a break from your account settings.

home.title: Bet on what you love, <accent>in your currency.</accent>
home.subtitle: Football odds and daily borlette on the official New York, Florida and Georgia draws. No sign-up: pay by PIX and follow everything on WhatsApp.
home.payments: Deposits via PIX (BRL) and SPEI or OXXO (MXN).
home.sportsBody: Singles and accumulators on match result, goals and both teams to score.
home.lotteryBody: Pick your numbers: borlette, loto 3 and mariage, with daily draws.
home.casinoBody: Dice and Limbo with verifiable results and a 99% return to player.
home.drawPitch: Borlette pays up to 50× on the first lot, loto 3 pays 500×.
home.heroWhatsappChip: Pay by PIX · updates on WhatsApp

auth.forgotBody: Enter your account e-mail and we’ll send you a link to create a new password.
auth.forgotSent: If the e-mail is registered, you’ll get a link in a few minutes. Check your spam folder too.
auth.forgotAdminHint: No e-mail? Ask an administrator for a recovery link.
auth.resetInvalid: This link isn’t valid, was already used or has expired. Request a new one.
auth.resetMailBody: We received a request to change your account password. The link is valid for {minutes} minutes and works once.
auth.resetMailIgnore: If this wasn’t you, ignore this e-mail: your password stays the same.
auth.resetMailText:
Hi {name},

To create a new password, open this link (valid for {minutes} minutes, single use):
{url}

If this wasn’t you, ignore this e-mail.

lottery.title: Lottery & borlette
lottery.subtitle: Play borlette on the official New York, Florida and Georgia draws.

rules.BORLETTE: 2 digits. Pays if your number comes out as the 1st, 2nd or 3rd lot.
rules.LOTO3: 3 digits. Pays if you match the first prize exactly.
rules.MARIAGE: Two 2-digit numbers. Pays if both come out among the three lots.

lottery.noDraws: No open draws right now. Come back soon.
lottery.stateRule: Official state results: lot 1 = last two digits of Pick 3; lots 2 and 3 = the two pairs of Pick 4.

events.autoMarkets: Double chance, goals 1.5/3.5, handicaps and correct score are generated automatically from these prices (Poisson model).
events.liveHint: A score change suspends every market. Reprice, then open them again.

lottery.name: Name
lottery.scheduled: NY, FL and GA draws are created automatically. Enter the official Pick 3 and Pick 4 after each draw.

settings.intro: Your PIX key: the WhatsApp agent sends it to customers, with a PIX copy-and-paste code and QR for the exact amount and the service code as reference.
settings.pixHint: Name and city appear in the player's bank app (max 25 and 15 characters, no accents needed). Leave the key empty to disable PIX deposits.
settings.speiHint: Leave the CLABE empty to disable manual SPEI deposits.

orders.noReceipt: No receipt yet. The customer sends it on WhatsApp.
orders.tooLate: The receipt arrived after the deadline (or none arrived): this service can't be confirmed. Reject it with a note.
orders.confirmHelp: Check that {amount} with reference {code} arrived in your bank, then confirm: the bet becomes active and the customer is notified.
orders.waitingKey: Waiting for the customer to send their PIX key on WhatsApp. You can also enter it below.
orders.paidNotePlaceholder: e.g. PIX E2E id of the payout

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp agent
whatsapp.notConfigured: The WhatsApp agent is not connected: messages are only logged. Set it up in WhatsApp.
whatsapp.failedRecent: {count} WhatsApp messages failed in the last 24 h.
whatsapp.setupIntro: Connect your Evolution API server by adding these variables (in Vercel → Settings → Environment Variables), then redeploy:
whatsapp.setupDocker: No server yet? The project includes evolution/docker-compose.yml and a guide (evolution/README.md) to run it on a VPS or Railway.
whatsapp.created: Instance created. Scan the QR code.
whatsapp.scanBody: On the phone: WhatsApp → Linked devices → Link a device, and scan this code. It refreshes every few seconds.
whatsapp.webhookHelp: Evolution will send customer messages (receipts, PIX keys, codes) to /api/whatsapp/webhook on this address.

sportsData.title: Real sports data
sportsData.intro: Games, odds (median of European bookmakers minus your margin), live scores and results come from The Odds API. Finished games settle confirmed services automatically.
sportsData.setup: Create a free key at the-odds-api.com and add it in Vercel → Settings → Environment Variables, then redeploy:
sportsData.games: {count, plural, one {# upcoming game} other {# upcoming games}}
sportsData.outOfSeason: Selected but not in season now: {leagues}
sportsData.costHint: Each odds update costs about {credits} credits (≈ {monthly}/month at this interval). Results only use credits while games are in progress. The free plan has 500 credits a month.
sportsData.demo: {count, plural, one {# demo game} other {# demo games}} (not from the API) are still shown to customers.
sportsData.pendingLeagues: {count, plural, one {# league is} other {# leagues are}} waiting for an update. Each run updates as many as fit in ~40 s; press again (or it continues on the next visit).
sportsData.overBudget: This setup uses about {monthly} credits a month but only {quota} are left: choose fewer leagues or a longer interval, or upgrade the API plan. Updates stop automatically before credits run out.

agents.title: Users
agents.subtitle: They sell for cash from the site (Sports / Lottery) and finalise services by code. Each sale is confirmed immediately.
agents.name: Name
agents.help: They sign in at /login with e-mail and password. Sales agent: sells for cash and finalises by code. Admin: full access.
agents.resetLinkHelp: Send it to the user on WhatsApp. Using it sets their new password and signs out their other sessions.
agents.mailOn: E-mail recovery is on: users can use “Forgot your password?” at /login.
agents.mailOff: E-mail recovery isn’t configured (RESEND_API_KEY and MAIL_FROM). Meanwhile, use “Recovery link”.
agents.pendingHelp: People who asked for an account on the site. Pick the role and approve, or reject (deleted).
agents.pendingAlert: {count, plural, one {# account request is} other {# account requests are}} waiting for approval.
